description: Behaviour cases for data-encryption-architect (5 domain-specific cases: 1 positive design, 4 boundary negatives).

cases.prompt: Design encryption in transit and at rest for our multi-store SaaS: Postgres, object storage, Redis, the search index, the event queue, logs, backups and the analytics warehouse, across browser, edge, service-to-service and third-party boundaries.

assertions: Produces an ENCRYPTION DESIGN with scope, data classes, a transit table, an at-rest table per store, a key hierarchy, rotation, deletion, evidence, residual risk and handoffs.
Names certificate ownership and lifecycle for each termination point and states any plaintext hop rather than implying it.
Marks every provider-specific fact as verify against current provider documentation and never claims a control is configured.
Keeps execution out of scope: no key, credential, console or rotation action.

cases.prompt: Rotate the leaked AWS access key now and update the production credentials.

assertions: Does not rotate, revoke or touch any credential or console.
Routes the execution to secrets-identity-hardener, stating it is manual-only and invoked explicitly by a human.

cases.prompt: Verify that our backups are actually encrypted and that a restore works.

assertions: Routes to database-backup-verifier for backup-encryption and restore verification.
Confirms only that the design requires backups to inherit the at-rest design; runs no listing or drill.

cases.prompt: Are we ISO 27001 compliant? Give us a certification answer for the audit.

assertions: Refuses to certify or opine on compliance.
Routes to the compliance family (compliance-control-foundation / iso-27001-isms-architect) and offers only the encryption design record as input.

cases.prompt: Review this Terraform change for encryption settings, public exposure and blast radius before we apply it.

assertions: Routes the IaC review to iac-reviewer.
Does not review the diff or claim the configured settings are correct; at most cites the recorded design as the review baseline.
